result.reviewScopeSummary: Read the Story 2 spec plus the full Epic 5 tech-design/test-plan set, then verified the checkpoint write path, latest-version summary projections, artifact review provenance payloads, and the shipped review UI/client coverage for Versioned Checkpoint Realignment.

newFindings.title: Review UI never surfaces the producing-process provenance that Story 2 adds to artifact versions
newFindings.evidence: Story 2 defines `producedByProcessId` and `producedByProcessDisplayLabel` as the version-provenance fields that make the producing process visible later (docs/spec-build/v2/epics/05--artifact-model-and-review-provenance-alignment/stories/02-versioned-checkpoint-realignment.md:56-98), and the client design says selected-version metadata and version-switcher rows must expose them (docs/spec-build/v2/epics/05--artifact-model-and-review-provenance-alignment/tech-design-client.md:343-345,402-407). The server now populates both fields on every version summary and selected-version detail (apps/platform/server/services/review/artifact-review.service.ts:141-165,205-326), but the shipped review UI never reads either field: apps/platform/client/features/review/artifact-review-panel.ts:28-106 renders only artifact/version labels and createdAt, and apps/platform/client/features/review/version-switcher.ts:25-109 renders only versionLabel/current/selected plus createdAt. A repo-wide search found no production client consumer of `producedByProcessId` or `producedByProcessDisplayLabel` under apps/platform/client/features, so a user reviewing earlier revisions still cannot see which process produced each version.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/artifacts.test.ts tests/service/server/project-shell-bootstrap-api.test.ts tests/service/server/artifact-review-api.test.ts tests/service/server/process-work-surface-api.test.ts --environment node
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/service/client/artifact-review-panel.test.ts tests/service/client/version-switcher.test.ts --environment jsdom

mockOrShimAuditFindings: No production-path mocks, shims, or fake adapters were found in the reviewed Story 2 runtime paths; the Convex-backed implementation uses real store/query surfaces.

Test-only shim note: InMemoryPlatformStore still fabricates a synthetic artifact version from legacy artifact-summary fields when no explicit version rows are seeded (apps/platform/server/services/projects/platform-store.ts:2965-2990). That behavior is limited to tests/in-memory flows, but it can hide provenance regressions if fixtures omit `artifactVersionsByArtifactId`.
additionalObservations: AC-2.1 and AC-2.3 are otherwise in good shape: convex/artifacts.ts:22-26 and 401-429 keep artifact identity project-scoped while appending new version rows, and convex/artifacts.ts:46-70 plus apps/platform/server/services/processes/readers/materials-section.reader.ts:19-50 make both project-shell and process-material reads consume latest-version projections.
`verify-all` passed, but the `test:e2e` lane is still scaffold-only and prints a skip message, so there is no browser-automation proof for the Story 2 review flow.
